_**Agent (copilot/claude-sonnet-5)**_

Confirmed: there's no `libs/` folder in the workspace even though root `package.json` declares `"libs/*"` as a workspace glob, and `shells/shell-dynamic/package.json` depends on `@mfe/shared-query: "*"` (and `@mfe/shared-store`) expecting them to resolve as local workspace packages. Since they don't exist locally, npm falls back to the public registry and 404s. 

`@mfe/shared-query` isn't actually imported/used anywhere in `shell-dynamic/src` — both it and `@mfe/shared-store` are unused leftover deps (the latter is only referenced in a commented-out import). Since the `libs/` workspace folder was never created, these `"*"` deps can't resolve locally and npm 404s trying to fetch them from the registry.

import HtmlWebpackPlugin from "html-webpack-plugin";
import { Configuration } from "webpack";
import type { Configuration as DevServerConfiguration } from "webpack-dev-server";

import { ModuleFederationPlugin } from "@module-federation/enhanced/webpack";
import path from "path";

const config: Configuration & { devServer?: DevServerConfiguration } = {
  mode: "development",
  entry: "./src/index.ts",
  resolve: {
    extensions: [".ts", ".tsx", ".js"],
  },
  module: {
    rules: [
      {
        test: /\.[jt]sx?$/,
        // ts-loader depends on ts.sys, which TypeScript 7 no longer exposes
        loader: "esbuild-loader",
        options: { loader: "ts", target: "es2020" },
        exclude: /node_modules/,
        // package.json has "type": "module", which forces fully-specified extensionless imports
        resolve: { fullySpecified: false },
      },
    ],
  },
  devServer: {
    port: 4001,
    // CORS:
    headers: { "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": "*" },
  },
  output: {
    publicPath: "http://localhost:4002/",
    path: path.resolve(__dirname, "dist"),
  },
  plugins: [
    new HtmlWebpackPlugin({
      template: "./public/index.html",
    }),
    new ModuleFederationPlugin({
      name: "remoteJs",
      filename: "remoteEntry.js",
      exposes: {
        "./Widget": "./src/Widget.tsx",
      },
      dts: {
        generateTypes: true,
      },
    }),
  ],
};

export default config;

import { init, registerRemotes, loadRemote } from '@module-federation/enhanced/runtime';

async function mountRemotes() {
  // Dynamic strategy: URLs come from a runtime-fetched config (could just as
  // easily be an API response), not from webpack.config.js.
  const remoteUrls: Record<string, string> = await fetch('/remotes.config.json').then((res) => res.json());

  init({ name: 'shellDynamic', remotes: [] });
  registerRemotes(Object.entries(remoteUrls).map(([name, entry]) => ({ name, entry })));

  await Promise.all([
    loadRemote('remoteJs/WebComponent'),
    loadRemote('remoteReact/WebComponent'),
    // loadRemote('remoteVue/WebComponent'),
  ]);

  const container = document.getElementById('remotes');
  if (!container) return;
  container.innerHTML = `
    <remote-js-widget label="From shell-dynamic"></remote-js-widget>
    <div>
      <p><strong>React bridge:</strong> well-known vs. hand-rolled</p>
      <remote-react-widget></remote-react-widget>
      <remote-react-widget-simple></remote-react-widget-simple>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p><strong>Vue bridge:</strong> well-known vs. hand-rolled</p>
      <remote-vue-widget></remote-vue-widget>
      <remote-vue-widget-simple></remote-vue-widget-simple>
    </div>
  `;
}

mountRemotes();

1. Root `node_modules` was missing `tsx`/`concurrently`/ because an earlier `npm install` aborted on the (now-resolved) `@mfe/shared-query` 404 → ran `npm install` at the workspace root.
2.  was hardcoded to , which doesn't parse JSX — `Widget.tsx`'s  broke the parser → changed to .
3. `webpack.config.ts` had  but no such file existed → added remote-react/src/index.ts mounting  into `#app`, and added the missing `#app` div to public/index.html.
4. `react`/`react-dom` were only in `devDependencies` as types, never installed as real deps → `npm install react react-dom -w remote-react`.
5.  was `4001` (colliding with `remote-js`) while  said `4002` and `experiments/module-federation-demo/shells/shell-dynamic/public/remotes.config.json` expects `remoteReact` on `4002` → corrected  to `4002` in `experiments/module-federation-demo/remotes/remote-react/webpack.config.ts`.

`npm run dev` in `remote-react` now compiles successfully and serves on `http://localhost:4002/`.

Note: `shell-dynamic/src/bootstrap.ts` loads `remoteReact/WebComponent`, but the config only exposes `./Widget` (a plain React component, no custom-element registration). That's a separate, larger gap — let me know if you want that wired up too.
